metadata.title: SELENE original appearance pack
metadata.author: SolidCraft contributors

provenance.origin: Original clean-room descriptions, numeric preview choices and analytic swatch geometry authored for SolidCraft.

metadata.document_kind: Authoring manifest; not a solidcraft-library/1 file and not an executable command script.

runtime_contract.target_binding: Copy runtime_parameters and add a nonempty bodies, faces or components selection from the pinned source design.
runtime_contract.supported_projection: Uniform opaque PBR with sRGB8 color, opacity exactly 1, metallic, roughness and dielectric_ior.
runtime_contract.component_binding: No source model, body, component, occurrence, joint or motion ID is bound in this file.

authoring_policy.preview_values: All color, metallic and roughness choices are original illustrative controls, not measurements or grade-specific claims.
authoring_policy.ior: The shared dielectric_ior value 1.5 is an unmeasured preview control. It affects the nonmetal fraction reflection only and does not enable refraction.
authoring_policy.advanced_values: Advanced numeric controls are original illustrative geometry or appearance inputs. They do not define engineering, manufacturing or mission requirements.
authoring_policy.unknown_optics: Spectral constants, optical thicknesses and scattering data remain unspecified where listed under unknown_optical_inputs.
authoring_policy.units: Procedural geometry uses millimetres; angles use radians; SolidCraft geometry is Z-up.
authoring_policy.capability_references: CAP IDs refer to docs/render-materials/capabilities.json. They describe target requirements, not proof that a runtime implements them.
authoring_policy.physical_material_separation: No density, modulus, conductivity, friction, thermal emissivity, electrical performance, sealing or flight-readiness data is assigned.
authoring_policy.lunar_surfaces: Lunar dust targets are granular deposits or particulate geometry in vacuum, never terrestrial airborne fog.
authoring_policy.model_and_motion: Appearance-only application must preserve geometry, transforms, engineering material assignment, joints, limits and motion data.

prepared_evidence.static_checks: Recipe count, unique IDs and names, source references, PBR bounds, exact projection keys, swatch-command correspondence and finite authoring values checked by the authoring step.
